output.population: 61 Mexican Spanish-speaking children between 6.0 and 8.5 years old, classified as early readers; monolingual, without neurological, developmental, or psychiatric diagnoses
output.summary: Preprocessed multishell diffusion MRI from Spanish-speaking Mexican children learning to read, released to study white matter pathways linked to phonological awareness and early reading. Cross-sectional observational design, de-identified, no in-scanner tasks.
